Problem: Delete a Given Value from a Singly Linked List
You are given N integers.
Create a Singly Linked List by inserting elements at the end.
Then you are given an integer X.
Your task is to delete the first occurrence of X from the linked list.
If X is not present, print:
Value Not Found
Otherwise, print the updated linked list after deletion.
Input Format
N
a1 a2 a3 ... aN
X
N → number of elements
Next line contains N space-separated integers
Last line contains integer X (value to delete)
Output Format
If deleted → print updated linked list
If not found → print "Value Not Found"
Constraints
1 ≤ N ≤ 1000
-10^9 ≤ ai, X ≤ 10^9
